original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. A gate job stands up the Aave fixturenet from the warm snapshot, runs the yield scenario and the redeem scenario, and tears down the fixturenet on exit. In the yield scenario the hub deposits USDC into waUSDC, a second account supplies USDC to the Aave pool and borrows USDC to raise utilization, time advances at least 60 seconds of blocks, and both waUSDC.convertToAssets(1e6) and the Aave USDC liquidityIndex increase. In the redeem scenario the hub redeems its waUSDC for USDC and its USDC balance grows by at least the yield scenario principal. A run without the borrow makes the yield check fail. The gate prints exactly two evidence lines. The gate never configures the Lido oracle. The gate leaves no running fixturenet deployment after it exits.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. No armada-assets-e2e scenarios gate job exists. No gate runs the Aave yield and redeem scenarios on the warm snapshot and tears down.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. Run scripts/armada-assets-e2e.py on the warm snapshot. stdout_json fixturenet_up is true. stdout_json scenario1_convert_to_assets_increased is true. stdout_json scenario1_liquidity_index_increased is true. stdout_json scenario1_blocks_advanced_seconds is at least 60. stdout_json scenario4_redeem_ge_principal is true. stdout_json scenario_line_count is 2. In a no-borrow run stdout_json yield_check_passed is false. After the gate exits no armada-assets-e2e deployment runs and the deployment directory is gone.
What constraints apply? State them in plain prose. The gate script does not call addOracleMember, submitReportData, submitReport, or setPrice. The gate tears down its fixturenet with an exit trap. The gate removes the deployment directory on exit.
restatement: A gate script, scripts/armada-assets-e2e.py, must stand up the Aave fixturenet from the warm snapshot and run two scenarios. In the yield scenario the hub deposits USDC into waUSDC. A second account supplies USDC to the Aave pool and borrows USDC to raise utilization. Time advances at least 60 seconds of blocks. Then waUSDC.convertToAssets(1e6) and the Aave USDC liquidityIndex must both increase. In the redeem scenario the hub redeems its waUSDC for USDC, and its USDC balance must grow by at least the yield scenario principal. A run without the borrow must make the yield check fail. The gate prints exactly two evidence lines. It never configures the Lido oracle. It tears down the fixturenet with an exit trap and removes the deployment directory, so nothing keeps running after it exits.

restatement_clauses.text: Running scripts/armada-assets-e2e.py on the warm snapshot brings the fixturenet up (stdout_json fixturenet_up is true). In the yield scenario, after at least 60 seconds of blocks (scenario1_blocks_advanced_seconds >= 60), waUSDC.convertToAssets(1e6) increased (scenario1_convert_to_assets_increased is true) and the Aave USDC liquidityIndex increased (scenario1_liquidity_index_increased is true).
In the redeem scenario the hub redeems its waUSDC for USDC and its USDC balance grows by at least the yield scenario principal (scenario4_redeem_ge_principal is true).
A run without the borrow makes the yield check fail (yield_check_passed is false).
The gate prints exactly two evidence lines (scenario_line_count is 2).
The gate script never calls addOracleMember, submitReportData, submitReport, or setPrice.
After the gate exits, no armada-assets-e2e deployment runs and the deployment directory is gone.
The gate tears down its fixturenet with an exit trap and removes the deployment directory on exit.

goal: Add an armada-assets-e2e gate that proves Aave yield accrues and is redeemable on the warm snapshot, then leaves nothing running.
acceptance_criteria: Run the gate on the warm snapshot. The fixturenet comes up, at least 60 seconds of blocks pass, and both the share price and the Aave liquidity index are higher afterwards.
Run the gate and check that redeeming all waUSDC gives the hub at least the USDC it first put in.
Run the gate with the borrow step skipped. The yield check must report that it failed.
Run the gate and count the evidence lines it prints. There must be exactly two.
The gate script contains none of the Lido oracle setup calls: addOracleMember, submitReportData, submitReport, setPrice.
Run the gate to completion, then look at the machine. No armada-assets-e2e deployment is running and its deployment directory does not exist.
The gate script registers an exit-time cleanup (atexit, a finally block, or a trap) that stops the fixturenet and removes the deployment directory.
